WHERE THE DEPTH GOES
Nothing is plugged into the back of the module:
the panel's ribbon goes to the driver board's own
24-pin socket, so the 9.15 over the cell is clear.
The recess is a 18 wide band on the centreline and
the driver carrier misses it, so the carrier datums
to the cover's REGISTER face at 22.6 - not to
cov_in 23.6, which is the skin datum, and not to
the recess floor's backing at 18.7:
board + tallest part, assumed 6. Measure it;
it is the only number holding this sheet up.
the register face gives 19.95, less the 2.5 the
pads lift the board off it for its solder joints
-> 17.45, against a measured stack of 16:
it fits by 1.45. Crossing the recess band
would cost another 3.9.
the cell DOES cross the recess band, so it rides a
platform level with the floor's back at 18.7;
it needs 6.9 of the 9.15 in front of that.
STLs export flat-face-down, as drawn (print_mirror = false)
